description: This file defines the Smarty_Undefined_Variable class, which handles undefined variables within the Smarty templating engine. It provides methods to manage property access and string conversions for variables that are not defined.

classes.name: Smarty_Undefined_Variable
classes.description: A class representing undefined variables in the Smarty templating engine, extending Smarty_Variable to provide custom behavior for undefined variables.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Returns null for any property accessed, indicating that undefined properties do not exist.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an empty string when the object is treated as a string.
